description: Roll out east-west firewall rules across a Kubernetes cluster using Calico network policies. Must: baseline current traffic patterns (which services talk to which), define allow-list rules based on observed traffic, deploy Calico policies in audit mode, verify no legitimate traffic is blocked, switch to enforce mode, and monitor for denied connections. Risk factors: allow-list missing infrequent traffic patterns, enforce mode blocking critical service-to-service communication, Calico policy ordering issues. Tools available: Calico, kubectl, Helm, Prometheus, tcpdump.
